(811)hrīḥpad+ma tsaṇ+ḍal ma ha kro dha h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥrang nyid pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i yi ge las 'od zer dmar po lcags

tei:div.tei:p: hrīḥpad+ma tsaṇ+ḍal ma ha kro dha h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rang nyid pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i yi ge las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas so so'i gnas nas spyan drangs par gyur/ ༁ྃ: kyai:ཿ phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na: nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na: btsan yul zangs dmar po na: pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pa: tshe btsan rol pa rkya bdun ni: phal cher sku mdog dmar po la: phyag na ba dan zhags pa bsnams: (812)sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: tshur byon tshur byon gnas 'dir byon: shu la triḥbadz+ra sa ma ya jaḥ bh+yoḥ btsan mkhar dkar po'i nang shed na: sha khrag longs spyod bsam mi khyab: yid 'ong spyan gzigs kun nas mjes: dam tshig gtsang ma'i gdan la bzhugasaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: kye skyes bu rol pa mched bdun ni: phrin las mjad pa bsam mi khyab: pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan paḥ dam tshig gnyer gtad (813)khyod la bstod: gtsang ma'i sku khrus 'di 'bul lo: bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la: thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mjod: ar+ghaṃ bi shud+dhe swā hā: gtsang ma'i bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs: me tog snang gsal dri chab dang : zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bulaḥ thugs rje'i dbang gis nye bar mjod: dhup+pe/ puṣ+pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shab+ta puts+tsha hoḥ kyai skyes bu srog gi bdag po ni: 'jigs byed rol pa sde (814)bdun tshogs: khyed la dgyes pa'i longs spyod ni: sha khrag dmar gtor ri ltar spungs: zag med bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil: rak+ta'i yon chab rdzing bur gtams: spyan gzigs longs spyod skar ltar bkram: rnga gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog: glu dbyangs snyan pa'i tshogs dang bcas: dam can mched bdun thugs dam bskang : btsan 'khor 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : sde brgyad sdong zla'i thugs dam bskang : dkor srung (815)dam can thugs dam bskang : las byed pho nya'i thugs dam bskang :

hūm̐ bse mkhar dmar po ldems se ldem: dar dmar ru mtshon pu ru ru: ba dan dmar po yengs se yeng : dregs pa mda' 'phen brengs se breng : las byed bshan pa rol lo lo: bshugs pa'i 'bod sgra di ri ri: tshe btsan rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la: khri sdeng lde'u btsan rje (816)rigs dang : rnal 'byor dam ldan brgyud par bcas: dam tshig gcig tu skyong ba la: sku la bsdo ba'i rigs brgyud chos: log lta'i sde dpung cham la phob: sngags 'chang rdo rje'i dam ma bral: bcol lo gnyer ro mthu rtsal bskyed: yal yol bri kol ma mjad cig: ngo srung zas phyir ma 'bring mjod: thugs dam 'gal ba bskangs gyur la: bu sdug tsha bo bzhin du skyongs: zhes bkod sbyin gsol kha'i 'di mnga' ri pad+ma dbang rgyal rol rtsal phyi mjad pa'o/ dge'o//
